text:
Marta: Quick heads-up — partner reported a perf/regression on their on-prem image when we pin CUDA 12.2 + NV driver 535.86. Happens under high-concurrency beams. Repro attached.
Kevin: Can you paste the minimal repro? Is this runtime-specific or general? @Satoshi FYI.
Marta: Repro: run loadgen against model on dedicated pool, tail latency jumps after ~2000 concurrent requests. Partner says `nvidia-smi` shows ECC resets. No core dumps yet.
Satoshi: Hmm, we've seen similar with 535.x and a new firmware on some Ampere SKUs. Could be kernel-driver mismatch. Which kernel is partner using?
Marta: They're on RHEL 8.6 with kernel 4.18.0-425.el8.x86_64. Partner vendor firmware v1.3.2.
Emily: Suggest immediate mitigation: pin to 525.x driver and CUDA12.1 image in marketplace until we validate. That buys time for hotfix.
Ryan: Agree — marketplace image rollback has to be coordinated with vendor comms. Timeline? We need a window for change and announcement copy for customers.
Marta: Partner asking for a coordinated rollback + joint advisory. They want announcement tomorrow morning PST if we can cut a patched image tonight.
Kevin: Ops notes: rollback steps are `cloud-marketplace images:promote --from=stable-525 --to=public` and we must update model-serving runtime config to use `cuda:12.1` tag.
Satoshi: I'll investigate whether a micro-hotpatch (driver recompile) is feasible tonight. If not, roll back.
Partners Bot: @Marta created ticket #PRTN-8891 and added vendor logs. Assigned to Satoshi.
Marta: Action list: 1) Satoshi attempt hotpatch (ETA 6h), 2) Kevin prepare rollback steps and hold window 02:00-03:00 UTC, 3) Emily draft joint advisory + internal incident blurb, 4) Ryan schedule marketplace image promotion and vendor signoff.
Emily: Draft advisory: short, apologize, explain regression affects certain driver/firmware combos under high concurrency, mitigation: use pinned CUDA12.1/driver 525 or wait for patch. Will share in #partners for signoff.
Kevin: Ops: adding @eng-oncall to the change window. Also we should add an automated canary in the marketplace pipeline to catch this pattern next time.
Satoshi: If I can't get a hotpatch by ETA, I'll open PR to pin Marketplace image and kick off rollback. Will attach test matrix.
Ryan: I'll coordinate announcement timing with partner comms — need final text by 01:30 UTC to go live at 02:00 UTC if rollback needed.
Marta: Thanks team. Keep updates in-thread. If you need exec escalation ping me directly. :thumbsup:
